scenes.line1: How do you size and design environments?
scenes.say: Sizing and environment design can make or break your app onboarding. How do you get it right, and why does it matter?

scenes.label: Math
scenes.sub: Use vendor guidance, load tests, and real usage—not guesses.
scenes.say: Always size from real data. Use vendor guidance, load tests, or current usage. Never guess.
Say your peak is 200 requests a second, and one instance handles 80. Divide, round up, add one for N plus one, and spread across two zones.
Stage must match production in topology. If it doesn't, your load tests can lie. Dev and test can be simpler.

scenes.question: How should you size your app?
scenes.wrong: Just guess based on gut feel.
scenes.right: Use real data, enable autoscale, and right-size after 30 days of metrics.
scenes.say: Interview trap: Never guess sizing. Panels want to see the math and a plan to adjust after real metrics.
